translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimula' kayu aa bale ruku tiyamula naajula bain chachilla' kejtsapala te'laramu tene judeeve. Tsejtu yalaa chachilla' mitya Diosa' ajuusha jijiimu detiyave, tsejtaa naa ujcha' mitya ufeenda juula bain, naa animaa juula bain tute' Diosnu kuwa kuwakenuu junmalaya tsa tsanguenu.

Tsa' mityaa naa chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimula' kayu aa bale rukula bain ne chachi dejutu, pudendyatyu deju', ne chachilla naatyamu deeñu bain tsaren deju' mitya, naajulaba mijtu, aseeta jutyu deju' tupiya' nentsaintsumulanu tenbikeenuu dejuve.
Tsejtu ya' ujcha' mitya bain, naa kumuinchi chachilla' ujcha' mitya bain Diosnu animaa tute' keewaawaa kenuu juve.
Matyu entsaa chachi tiya' balengura' keewaranu tiyamu, ne maali tsaichi tya' tiyanu jutyuve, matyu Diosya tsaa tirenu mika' tsangue bale tire' katakaamuve, Aarónnu naake'ba juntsaju.

Tsaren ju' Cristo bain chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimula' kayu aa bale ruku tiyatu, maali tsaichi tyataa tsa indyuve, matyu Diosyaa juntsaa tire' balengurekaanu kiñaa tsaive, ya enu entsandimuwaañu' mitya:
Tsenmin Diosa' Kiikanu vee mujtu bain entsandive:

content.text: Ñaa chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimu naa-uwanuba tsanamu juve,

content: Entsa tusha Cristo chuumala, mika llakindya' daran palaachi pa' Diosba kuinda ke' tutanu juñuba livee kikenuu jumu Diosnu u'tandiñu, Dios meenguemuwaave, yanu mika meengue', naakesa tyañuba tsa tsanguemuñu' mitya.
Tsa' mitya, ura pañuya naa Cristo, Diosa' Naren ju'ba tsai' llakingue' taaju ke' meenguen chutu naa-i taaju ken chunuu juñuba mijamuwaave.
Juntsa-i' Dioschiya naajunuuñuba tsaitu, munu bain ya' mityan naa-uwanuba liveeju chunuu tireve naajulaa yanu demeenguiñuba.
Matyu Dios yanu chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimula' kayu aa bale ruku tirekive, Melquisedec naajuwaañuba juntsaa.
Kayu keengue' jintsu', kailla juuñuu tsanatyudei.
Entsa kuindatala mika panu jukeeve, tsaaren yuj taaju' wandyanu juve ñulla te' aseetanguityu tiya deiñu' mitya.

Ñulla dekeenguiñu yumaa pure' tinbu juuñu' mitya, ñullaa mijakaamu majuunu dejuve tennaren, tsa dejutyuñu, ka naa taaju' wandyaba jutyu Dioschi mijakaratalaren demamijakarainuu ma judeeve. Matyu kailla jun tsaa demandiya', jalla' fainuu panda finu dejutyu', chu'piren kujchaañuu mandiya deive.
Tsaju' chu'piren kujchaa añuñu juuñuulaya tyee urañu bain, tyee urajtuñu bain aseetanguenu mijdetuve.
Tsaju' ura pandaya yumaa aawalaa fimu deeve, yumaa tinu bain ura' pensangue' kemula, matyu yalaa tyee urañu bain, tyee urajtuñu bain yumaa mide' mitya.
